meta.name: competitive-research-snapshot
meta.description: Research a competitive landscape with cited snapshots, a comparison matrix, and so-what implications. Use when a product decision needs competitive grounding, not a market report.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 快速生成竞品对比矩阵与行动建议
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果做产品决策前需要快速了解竞品格局
copy.tagline_en: Generate competitive comparison matrix and actionable insights quickly
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need quick competitive grounding before product decisions

howto.what: Claude会按固定流程做竞品研究:先给搜索计划,选定3~4个对手,只做“够用”的调研,每条信息标事实/推断/假设并附真实网址,输出固定结构快照(范围、对手快照、对比矩阵、So What),最后给4个后续选项。
howto.when: 当产品决策(如定位、路线图、交易支持)需要竞争依据,而非市场报告时触发;用户提供公司、产品或细分市场,或要求“做竞品快照”时启用。

say.text: 对我们的报销自动化产品做个竞争快照,支持Q1路线图决策。
say.note: 会产出带引用和标签的对比快照。

say.text: 研究一下我们和主要对手的强弱项,给三点策略启示。
我要做董事会汇报,给我一份竞争证据快照,标注事实与推断。
say.note: 输出稳定格式,便于后续diff。

howto.what_en: Claude follows a fixed workflow: search plan, 3-4 competitor selection, just-enough research, facts/inferences/assumptions labeled with real URLs, and a stable snapshot (scope, snapshots, matrix, so-what) plus 4 follow-up options.
howto.when_en: Triggers when a product decision (positioning, roadmap, deal support) needs competitive grounding, not a market report — e.g. user names a company/product/segment or asks for a competitive snapshot.

say_en.text: Run a competitive snapshot on our expense-app to support Q1 roadmap decisions.
say_en.note: Produces a cited, labeled comparison snapshot.

say_en.text: Research our top three competitors' pricing and positioning, with sources.
For board prep, give me a competitive snapshot with facts/inferences labeled.
